MonitoringProgramDescription: Since 2006 TRPA has conducted basin-wide travel surveys every two years in order to better understand basic travel characteristics of both residents and visitors. The data collected - which includes data points such as mode share, origin-destinations, and trip purpose - is used for a variety of purposes at TRPA including regional performance metrics, project planning, and travel demand modelling.
MonitoringApproach: The dashboard below summarises TRPA's 2018 Summer Travel Survey, which was conducted in late-August of 2018.
